title: General Refund Policy
text: Refund requests must be raised within 48 hours of delivery. Only delivered orders are eligible for a refund. Every refund request is reviewed by a human support agent before it is approved. A refund can never be more than the order total.

title: Delivery Delay Policy
text: If an order is delivered more than 30 minutes after the promised delivery time, the customer is eligible for a refund of 25 percent of the order total, up to a maximum of 150 rupees. Delays of 30 minutes or less are not eligible for compensation.

title: Missing Items Policy
text: If an item is missing from a delivered order, the customer can request a refund equal to the value of the missing items. The refund can never exceed the order total. The customer should report the missing item within 48 hours of delivery.

title: Food Quality and Wrong Item Policy
text: If the food is spoiled, of poor quality, or the wrong item was delivered, the customer can request a refund up to the order total with a maximum of 500 rupees per order. Support may ask for a photo of the item.

title: Order Cancellation Policy
text: An order can be cancelled for free until the restaurant starts preparing it. After preparation starts, cancellation is not possible and no refund is given for a customer-initiated cancellation.

title: Refund Payment Timeline
text: Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method within 3 to 5 business days. Cash-on-delivery orders are refunded as Zomato credits, which are available immediately.

title: Human Support and Approvals
text: Customers can ask for a human agent at any time. The AI assistant can only create a refund request. A human support agent approves or rejects it, usually within a few working hours. The assistant must never promise that a refund will be approved.
